evidence_status_model.title: Evidence status, sufficiency, acceptance, expiry, and revalidation ledger
evidence_status_model.statement: The authoritative evidence status vocabulary and per-requirement ledger controlling evidence, validity, sufficiency, and acceptance state, scope, version, environment, configuration, expiry, and revalidation trigger.
evidence_status_model.prohibited_inference: Submitted is not valid, valid is not sufficient, sufficient is not accepted, and accepted is not current indefinitely.

evidence_sufficiency_requirements.title: Evidence sufficiency requirement
evidence_sufficiency_requirements.statement: The requirement that accepted evidence be assessed for sufficiency against its authoritative requirement, scope, and coverage before it can support any acceptance.

evidence_acceptance_requirements.title: Evidence acceptance requirement
evidence_acceptance_requirements.statement: The requirement that acceptance of any evidence be recorded by the named acceptance authority against sufficient, valid, and current evidence.

evidence_revalidation_requirements.title: Evidence revalidation requirement
evidence_revalidation_requirements.statement: The requirement that accepted evidence be revalidated when its scope, configuration, environment, or expiry changes, so that stale evidence cannot support a current acceptance.
